parts.label: (a)
parts.text: An aqueous solution of chromium(III) contains the green $\text{[Cr(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{3+}$ complex ion.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Complete the electronic configuration of an isolated, gaseous $\text{Cr}^{3+}$ ion.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
$\text{[Cr(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$ shows some similar chemical properties to $\text{[Co(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$.

Samples of $\text{[Cr(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{3+}$ are reacted separately with either $\text{NaOH(aq)}$, $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{(aq)}$, or excess $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$.

Use this information and the Data Booklet to suggest the formula of the chromium species formed. State the type of reaction taking place in each case.

| reagent added to $\text{[Cr(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$ | formula of chromium species formed | type of reaction |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ |  |  |
| $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |
| an excess of $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
$\text{[Cr(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{2+}$ and $\text{[Cr}_2\text{(O}_2\text{CCH}_3\text{)}_4\text{(H}_2\text{O)}_2\text{]}$ are both complexes of chromium(II) and have different colours.

Explain why the colours of these complexes are different.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The structure of $\text{[Cr}_2\text{(O}_2\text{CCH}_3\text{)}_4\text{(H}_2\text{O)}_2\text{]}$ is shown. Ethanoate ions act as ligands in this complex. The ethanoate ligand, $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_2^-$, is shown as $\text{O}-\text{O}$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Water and ethanoate ions behave as different types of ligand in this complex.

Suggest an explanation for this statement.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce the coordination number of Cr and the geometry around each Cr atom in this structure.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: State the type of bond between the two atoms in the Cr-Cr bond.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
The $\text{[Cr}_2\text{(O}_2\text{CCH}_3\text{)}_4\text{(H}_2\text{O)}_2\text{]}$ complex reacts with aqueous acid to form $\text{Cr}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ ions.

$\text{Cr}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ ions react with $\text{O}_2\text{(aq)}$ under acidic conditions. $\text{Cr}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$ ions are formed.

Use the Data Booklet to answer the following questions.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: Construct an ionic equation for the reaction of $\text{Cr}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ with $\text{O}_2\text{(aq)}$ under acidic conditions.
